meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: Transform data into compelling narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. Use when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把数据变成有说服力的故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常需要向别人解释数据背后的含义
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain the meaning behind data to others

howto.what: Claude 会把数据整理成有背景、冲突和结论的故事，给出关键洞察与行动建议，并为报告配上合适的图表说明和演示结构。
howto.when: 当你说要做数据分析报告、高管演示，或要把结论讲给非技术听众时触发。

say.text: 把这份月度数据做成高管摘要，标题要抓人。
say.note: Claude 会按洞察、数据、启示组织内容。

say.text: 用趋势故事框架分析这两个季度的变化。
say.note: 会生成包含背景、变化和洞察的叙事。

say.text: 帮我做一个问题解决型的客户流失分析。
say.note: 按 Hook、问题、洞察、解决方案展开。

howto.what_en: Claude organizes raw data into a narrative with setup, conflict, and resolution, highlighting insights, recommendations, and suitable visuals for reports or presentations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for analytics reports, executive presentations, or explaining insights to non-technical audiences.

say_en.text: Turn this monthly data into an executive summary with a strong headline.
say_en.note: Claude structures it with insight, data, and implications.

say_en.text: Use the trend story framework to compare these two quarters.
say_en.note: Generates a narrative with context, change, and insight.

say_en.text: Create a problem-solution story for customer churn.
